title: 第15章 贪功第16章 强征求追读求收藏求月票推荐票
content_zh:
三当家今日遇到了太多的意外。
那个贪生怕死的邢兆福竟然不要命、那些废柴捕快竟然也不要命……
现在连一个泥腿子也不要命了？
三当家没想到随便碰到一个泥腿子，竟然敢对他先下手为强！
他急忙闭眼后退，但仍然是慢了一步。
少量的白灰进了眼睛，一下子就感觉眼睛火辣辣的疼。
若是放在平时，他随手一挥就能驱散这些白灰。
虎落平阳被犬欺啊！
自己堂堂黑龙寨三当家，竟然被这种低劣的手段给偷袭了！
电光火石之间，黑龙寨三当家睁不开双眼，耳边却听见一道凌厉的破空声。
“不好！”
三当家心中一沉，这一下子就知道袭来的绝对不是那种寻常的泥腿子，绝对是个真正的练家子！
他连忙挥起一刀向前挡去。
叮叮当当。
几个呼吸之间，两柄刀至少碰撞了不下十几次。
这十几次碰撞，让三当家的心沉到了谷底。
对方的刀并没有多大力量，甚至都没有踏入淬体的门槛，但刀法却是颇为熟练，起码已经小成。
如果是平时，这等实力当然不会被他放在眼里。
但是现在他身受重伤，眼睛更是无法视物，身体一动就撕裂般的疼痛。
最主要的是，邢兆福那个疯狗还在追着自己，如果不能快速将此人拿下，一旦被邢兆福那些人听到动静，自己今日就真的在劫难逃了。

“兄弟住手。”
一念至此，三当家一边艰难地抵挡，一边声音沙哑的低声喊道。
“你想做什么？”
苏牧动作稍微放缓了一些。
三当家察觉到苏牧的变化，又听到苏牧开口回应，心中顿时一松。
“兄弟，我乃黑龙寨三当家，你若是求财，我可以与你黄金百两，且罢手如何？”
三当家说道。
邢兆福用银子驱使那些捕快围攻他，他难道就不能用银子来诱惑此人？
看此人的穿着，应该是穷困潦倒。
黄金百两，绝对可以让他心动！
果然，三当家感觉对面的招式放缓了许多，似乎是在犹豫。
“黄金二百两！”
三当家有些急迫地加码。
“好。”
对面终于传来了声音。
三当家心中顿时一松，双腿都因为失血过多而有些发软。
就在这个时候，对方原本已经停下的动作，刹那间再度爆发。
content_en:
The Third Master encountered too many surprises today.
Xing Zhaofu, who was greedy for life and fearful of death, actually didn't want to die, and those good-for-nothing detectives didn't even want to die either...
Now you don't even want to kill a mud-legged person?
The Third Master didn't expect that when he met a random guy with mud legs, he would dare to attack him first!
He hurriedly closed his eyes and backed away, but still took a step slowly.
A small amount of white ash got into my eyes, and my eyes suddenly felt burning and painful.
Normally, he would be able to disperse the white dust with a wave of his hand.
The tiger fell down and was bullied by the dog!
The dignified third master of Black Dragon Village was unexpectedly attacked by such despicable means!
In the midst of the lightning and flint, the third master of Black Dragon Village could not open his eyes, but heard a sharp sound breaking through the air.
"Not good!"
The third master's heart sank, and he knew at once that the one who attacked him was definitely not the ordinary mud-legged guy, he was definitely a real practitioner!
He quickly swung his knife to block it.
Ding-ding-ding-ding.
In a few breaths, the two knives collided at least a dozen times.
These dozen collisions made the third master's heart sink to the bottom.
The opponent's sword didn't have much power, and it hadn't even reached the threshold of body tempering, but his sword skills were quite proficient, at least he had achieved some success.
If it were normal times, this level of strength would certainly not be taken seriously by him.
But now he was seriously injured, his eyes were unable to see, and his body was in pain like tearing whenever he moved.
The most important thing is that the mad dog Xing Zhaofu is still chasing him. If he can't capture this person quickly, once Xing Zhaofu and others hear the news, he will really be in doom today.
"Brother stop it."
At this thought, the Third Master resisted with difficulty and shouted in a hoarse voice.
"What do you want to do?"
Su Mu slowed down a little.
The Third Master noticed Su Mu's change and heard Su Mu respond, and felt relieved.
"Brother, I am the third head of the Black Dragon Village. If you want money, I can give you a hundred taels of gold. How about we stop?"
The third master said.
Xing Zhaofu used money to drive those agents to besiege him. Couldn't he use money to seduce this person?
Judging by the way this man is dressed, he must be in poverty.
A hundred taels of gold can definitely make his heart flutter!
Sure enough, the third master felt that the opponent's moves had slowed down a lot, as if he was hesitating.
"Two hundred taels of gold!"
The Third Master increased the stakes with some urgency.
"Okay."
A voice finally came from the other side.
The Third Master felt relieved immediately, and his legs were a little weak due to excessive blood loss.
At this moment, the opponent's movements that had stopped suddenly broke out again.
